senses.gloss:
म्लिष्ट म्लिष्ट, &c. See under rt. म्लेछ्
below.

म्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. Pāṇ. VII. 2, 18], spoken
barbarously or indistinctly, indistinct (as speech),
foreign, barbarous; = म्लान, withered, faded, faint;
(अम्), n. indistinct speech, a foreign language.
—म्लिष्टोक्ति (˚ट-उक्˚), इस्, f. indistinct or bar-
barous speech.
